Re-time edited lines
No line here has estimated word timings or is missing them. To re-time another line, tap it and choose Re-time words.
This line has no place in the recording, so its words can\'t be re-timed.
Re-timing words needs the meeting\'s recording, and this meeting has none.
Re-timing words works for English speech only, and this meeting\'s language is another.
This transcript is an English translation of speech in another language, so its words can\'t be timed against the recording.
Is this meeting in English?
Recap doesn\'t know which language this meeting is in. Re-timing works for English speech only; on speech in another language it would place the words wrongly.
It\'s English, re-time
Download the word re-timing model?

Re-timing words needs an English pronunciation model: a %1$s download from GitHub (the sherpa-onnx project), %2$s once unpacked. Re-timing then runs on this phone; nothing from your meetings is sent anywhere. You can delete the model in Settings.
Download

Re-timing words needs an English pronunciation model. Its download is on this phone but was not unpacked, perhaps because the phone ran out of space. Unpacking it needs %1$s free and downloads nothing again. You can also delete the download in Settings.

These lines have word timings that were estimated when you edited them, or no word timings at all. They are measured against the recording again, on this phone. Only the timings change, never the words. A line you edit while this runs keeps your edit.
Re-time

Word re-timing (English)

After you edit a transcript line, its word timings are estimated. Re-time words measures them against the recording again, on this phone, so tapping a word and the highlight during playback follow the audio. For English meetings; needs an optional model.
